root_cause.text: The function mt7925_mac_write_txwi_80211() accesses fields of management frames (such as category and action code) without verifying that the frame length is sufficient, leading to a potential out-of-bounds read when processing a short IEEE 802.11 action frame.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a length check `skb->len >= IEEE80211_MIN_ACTION_SIZE + 1` before accessing `mgmt->u.action.category`, which was previously missing, and the CVE description explicitly states "Check frame length before accessing the mgmt fields in order to avoid a possible oob access."
